verification ladder use the deepest relevant layer available: 1. source readback. 2. static or syntax validation. 3. focused unit or module checks. 4. integration/api verification. 5. runtime or browser interaction. 6. deployment activation evidence. 7. live public response. 8. user visible behavior on the affected surface. a higher layer does not excuse skipping the lower layer needed to
